name: grimmsnarl_ml_v2
deck_note: Unchanged from v1: the list 21 of the top-50 Grimmsnarl teams run card for card.
teacher_selection_note: v1 pinned the pilot that maximised agreement, which selected the weakest teacher in the corpus (rank 48, 1048.5): agreement with a pilot is inversely related to that pilot's rating, so optimising fidelity alone walks down the leaderboard. v2 selects on rating and attainable agreement together. 16494330 is 29.1 rating points stronger than v1's pin and is also imitated more accurately (92.23% vs 90.00% on the same all-context metric).
policy: Imitation ranker over the top-50 Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex corpus. The v2.1 LightGBM lambdarank booster (919 trees, 731 board/action features plus the teacher-id feature) is fitted without outcome or rating weights on 287,828 decisions from 3,655 games and 21 pilots sharing one deck list. Inference pins pilot 16494330. Effective damage now accounts for wall abilities, Weakness/Resistance, Neutralization Zone and Battle Cage; Boss timing separates a gustable target from an immediate KO; DAMAGE_COUNTER and REMOVE_DAMAGE_COUNTER use their correct target ownership and damage semantics. Every corpus-scorable single-pick context, including context 8, is routed through the ranker. Multi-pick, skill-order, discard and face-down prize choices stay with marnies_grimmsnarl_ex_v7. Rule-routed choices are recorded in turn history, while teacher-forced evaluation never records the model's unchosen prediction. Early stopping uses strict Top-1 only.
validation_scope: 88 v2 tests pass. Deck remains 60 cards and 19 unique. Chronological per-team test strict Top-1 is 84.84% across all 21 pilots (n=34,611); pinned-pilot offline Top-1 is 91.96% (n=1,480). End-to-end corrected teacher-forced agreement on the pinned pilot's later 18 games is 91.34% (n=1,420), versus 91.62% for v2.0; REMOVE_DAMAGE_COUNTER improves from 91.67% to 95.83%. On 60 wall-heavy episodes, all-context agreement improves from 88.53% to 89.61%, MAIN from 86.07% to 87.39%, and wall-prize attack count matches the teachers at 11/11. Paired local self-play: 21-19 versus v2.0 and 25-5 versus v1; 0 crashes, 0 illegal selects and 0 policy/observation fallbacks. Average v2.1 inference was 28.85-29.54 ms/move in these runs. Ladder rating is NOT measured.
description: v2.1 fixes wall, damage-counter and Boss-order semantics, prevents context-gating and teacher-forcing history corruption, and retrains the all-context ranker. It improves wall-heavy replay agreement by 1.08 points without losing paired self-play strength versus v2.0. Win-weighted and leaderboard-rating-weighted fits were tested and rejected because both reduced held-out Top-1.
